Officer's narrative
Responding officer was dispatched to a reported rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 was stopped in traffic
when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee,
which Driver 1 said struck the lower dash during the impact. The reported injury is consistent with this type of
collision. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat, and the officer and both drivers confirmed Passenger's
presence in the vehicle at the time. The rear damage to Driver 1's vehicle matches the impact as described by both
drivers. No earlier damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. No independent witnesses were located, no
photographs of the scene were provided, and no other report of this collision was found. Driver 1 is listed as a named
driver on the policy presented at the scene.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
